notes.title: Demo update v0.02.018
notes.content: [p]Hi All![/p][p][/p][p]Updated the visuals again, now I am actually quite happy with it. You can now make the game super intense like in the trailer, or make it easy on the eyes. There are some presets, but also sliders with direct visual feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]Updated in this version:[/p][list][*][p]Visual overhaul (again) but now I am finally satisfied[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the visual settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added pulsing hurt animation on low health[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned shop little bit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when leaving level while punching[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in nail to wall (or actually re-implemented a past bug that became a feature, but broke with some previous update)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed de-saturation on dead[/p][/*][*][p]Removed enemy shadows[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy damage in later levels a bit[/p][/*][*][p]Improved homing on melee attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced player damage when nailed to wall by enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Added hurt graphic to dead screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update v0.02.015
notes.content: [p]Hi All![/p][p][/p][p]You can now add Boss enemies to the Boss levels by activating the "more boss" difficulty modifier at the start of your run! Let me know if you can beat him![/p][p][/p][p]Check out this short to get a sneak peak how it was designed:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VZKIOhkapQE"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Updated in this version:[/p][list][*][p]added difficulty option to add boss enemies to the boss levels,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed riot shield reflecting bullets with trigger[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Glass Canon (will probably come back later)[/p][/*][*][p]Made rerolls cheaper but double every reroll[/p][/*][*][p]Added text to double mod cross in inventory, to make it more clear what is going on[/p][/*][*][p]Updated how cards combine, you can now reduce insane scaling from combining God cards by combining with a normal card[/p][/*][*][p]tweaked visual pre-set settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug not saving HP player correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Added base HP player to inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound homing playing to much[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo in menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update v0.02.012
notes.content: [p]Hi All![/p][p][/p][p]There is now a Discord server: [url="https://discord.com/invite/m8368kryMU"]https://discord.com/invite/m8368kryMU[/url][/p][p]Pretty big update to the visuals, check out the presets in the visual menu![/p][p][/p][p]Updated in this version:: [/p][list][*][p]Added Discord server link to game ([url="https://discord.com/invite/m8368kryMU"]https://discord.com/invite/m8368kryMU[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default keyboard key binding for swap guns to "Q" and made "shift" Dash[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Visual editor for visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Presets for visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced Glass-canon[/p][/*][*][p]Moved fps counter[/p][/*][*][p]Improved main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added animation to Health pack, indicating it will disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in gun muzzle flash[/p][/*][*][p]Added click indicator to add multiplier to card event[/p][/*][*][p]Improved backgrounds menu's slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Better sound indicator when magazine is almost empty[/p][/*][*][p]Cancel out of Shop and Level overview with ESC[/p][/*][*][p]In inventory hold the Dash button and click card to move cards directly to you card storage[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update v0.02.010
notes.content:
[p]Updated in this version:[/p][list][*][p]Added a link to a feedback form[/p][/*][*][p]Money numbers now are bigger if they are high[/p][/*][*][p]Added "thank you for playing" to the demo end screen. notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.content: [p][b]Hi Everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Releases[/h2][p]Good news, the [b][u]Flashes of Chaos Demo[/u][/b] will release [u][b]August 8, 2025[/b][/u].[/p][p][/p][h2]Playtest End[/h2][p]Thank you all for playing the Flashes of Chaos Playtest! Your feedback has been very valuable to improve the Flashes of Chaos Demo experience! As the Demo will release August 8, the playtest will also close on August 8. In the future there will likely be a new playtest for the full game. If you want to get updated on this you can join the mailing list at [url="https://brainburnstudio.com"]brainburnstudio.com[/url]. [/p][p][/p][h2]Update Overview From Playtest[/h2][p]Overview of the main updates as the result of the playtest are in no particular order:[/p][list][*][p]Replaced boring modifiers with not boring modifiers. All modifiers now synergizes at least with one other modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Added a story to the game/demo[/p][/*][*][p]Added a increased difficulty option to the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Custom crosshairs per gun[/p][/*][*][p]Many UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Many tutorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some fatal crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a lot of settings to adjust the visuals of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Better visuals for explosions and Melee attacks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Store Page Overhaul[/h2][p]To celebrate the upcoming release of the Demo, the story page has gotten a complete overhaul, with new screenshots and soon a updated trailer for the Demo release.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448178/0704c098b467e0099b3680955f7b01421c3c6289.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Beta playtest for Flashes of Chaos DEMO is LIVE
notes.content:
[p][b]Beta playtest for the [i]Flashes of Chaos[/i] DEMO is now live![/b][/p][p]
This version is planned to be the official Demo for [i]Flashes of Chaos[/i]. As an action roguelike, it offers multiple hours of replayable gameplay. Each Demo run takes around [b]15–30 minutes[/b].[/p][p][b]Have fun![/b] And feel free to share your feedback—I'd love to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][h1]Bugs: [/h1][p]Please report bugs to [url="https://support@brainburnstudio.com"]support@brainburnstudio.com[/url]. [/p][p]When reporting a bug please include a screenshot, or copy of the error message. [/p][p][/p][h1]Feedback:[/h1][p]You can mail me the feedback ([url="https://support@brainburnstudio.com"]support@brainburnstudio.com[/url]), or post it on the Steam community server. In the future I might create a Discord server. [/p][p][/p]
